summary: The binary has no import cycles, and that is the only structural rule the compiler enforces. Layers are implicit. Directory names read like layers (network/, ui/, review/, proc/) but their members span L0 to L10, so a path says little about what a package may import. Most of the damage comes from a few packages used as a source of constants: four packages import the 20k-line internal/agent for a single path or token helper, and four import internal/memory mainly for a directory and a lock. Moving those small pieces down removes most heavy edges without touching behaviour. Dependency numbers on this page are scanned live from the source; prose and findings are dated to the audit above.

rules.title: Imports point down the layers
rules.detail: entry > app > domain > platform > foundation. Nothing imports internal/cli. The app packages (hooks, launch, configure) are imported only from cli or each other's narrow helpers.

rules.title: Foundation stays stdlib-only
rules.detail: paths, proc, textutil, models, ui/ansi, secrets/shapes, buildver have no internal imports. Anything added here must keep that true. schemas (imports only paths) and audit sit just above.

rules.title: Never import a heavy package for a constant
rules.detail: If you need one path, name, header or lock from a big package, move that symbol down to a leaf instead. This is the main source of false height in the graph today.

rules.title: A directory is a namespace, not a layer
rules.detail: Say which kind a child is. Kind A imports its parent (agent/tree, agent/tools, agent/preflight) and can never be imported by the parent. Kind B is imported by the parent (agent/project, secrets/shapes, usage/usageledger) and must not import it. Before nesting, check the Import check tab.

rules.title: External SDKs are boxed in one package
rules.detail: CLAUDE.md rule. anthropicsdk and copilotsdk are the boxes; a third-party import outside its box is a finding. bbolt and mdsmith are unboxed libraries today (F-B2).

rules.title: Break a cycle by moving code down, not by injecting
rules.detail: First extract the shared piece to a lower package. Injection is only for a true inversion (a low package must call a high one), and then as an explicit field on an options struct passed by the caller. No cross-package assignment from init().

rules.title: cli parses, engines work
rules.detail: internal/cli holds the verb table and flag handling; engines take typed options and return values. A verb file over 300 lines usually holds an engine. Exceptions today: databricks.Run, clean.Run and review/* own their own flag parsing (F-S9).

rules.title: *test packages are test-only
rules.detail: hosttest, pathstest and vaulttest are imported only from _test.go files, so their importer count reads 0 in production imports.

findings.title: internal/agent is several packages in one
findings.evidence: 97 non-test files, about 19,800 lines (18% of the Go code), 24 internal imports. File prefixes already mark the clusters: launch_*, render_*, job*, live*, review*, copilot*, opencode*, gemini*, codex*, schema*, roster*.
findings.fix: P9. Extract the clusters that need no engine internals first.

findings.title: Four packages import internal/agent for a path or token
findings.evidence: history: CodexConfigPath. clean: CopilotRegistryGlob, CopilotRegistryKeep. network/web: DispatchDir. usage: CodexHome, OpencodeDBPath, CopilotPlanName, CodexAccessToken. Each sits at L9 or L10 because of it.
findings.fix: P2. Move the locations to paths.

findings.title: internal/memory is used as a path and lock provider
findings.evidence: agent uses NativeDir, ProjectSlug, HandoffsDir, Dir. worktree uses Dir, EnsureRepoDir, WithBankLock, BankLockWait. clean uses BankLockPath, StoreDir, JournalDir, AccessStateDir. setup uses Dir, BankFiles, Init, WithBankLock. This edge also pulls proxy and providers under agent.
findings.fix: P3. Extract memory/store.

findings.title: Shell quoting lives in network/tailscale
findings.evidence: agent imports tailscale only for QuoteSH, QuotePath, StreamArgs, ValidHost, ValidCredential (client.go, remote.go, signin.go). The wrap-up report also counts 4 POSIX-quote copies.
findings.fix: Move QuoteSH and QuotePath to textutil, then re-check what agent still needs.

findings.title: Engine packages prompt the terminal
findings.evidence: agent/signin.go calls ui/tui Secret and StdinIsTerminal, and databricks.LoginRow and RemovedFlagHint. databricks/import.go calls tui.Pick. Prompts inside engines also caused the OfferConfigure seam.
findings.fix: Return a typed need-input result, or take a prompt callback, and let cli drive tui.

findings.title: proxy client helpers force imports of the server
findings.evidence: memory/embed.go uses proxy.Running, Base, ClientHeader, ClientSecret. statusline uses ReadState, State, Health. agent uses AgentHeader, SessionBase, Ensure and token minting. All pull in translate, usageledger and secrets.
findings.fix: P4. Extract proxy/client.

findings.title: secrets sits above providers, which needs secrets
findings.evidence: secrets.Get reaches providers.EffectiveSecret, and providers.SealSecret calls back through RegisterSealer in an init(). So tailscale and network/mcp inherit the whole provider registry to read one value.
findings.fix: P5. Put a store leaf under both.

findings.title: 16 non-test files exceed the 600-line limit
findings.evidence: proxy/router.go 1092, configure/configure.go 918, cli/agent.go 873, memory/native.go 847, agent/agent.go 815, transcript/transcript.go 780, cli/providers.go 668, cli/memory.go 656, hooks/memory.go 650, cli/vault_table.go 649, review/diff/report.go 637, launch/install_steps.go 637, configure/claude_settings.go 616, memory/embed.go 614, agent/route.go 604, launch/install.go 601. internal/cli totals about 10,850 lines against a verb-handlers-only rule.
findings.fix: Split the cli ones first; they are where engine code hides.

findings.title: Some verbs parse flags outside internal/cli
findings.evidence: databricks.Run and clean.Run are wired straight into the verb table. review/source, review/diff, review/plan, review/mutate and review/ramdisk import ui/helptext to build their own pages.
findings.fix: Pick one rule and record it. Letting a self-contained tool own its parser is reasonable, but CLAUDE.md does not say so today.

findings.title: Names that collide or mislead
findings.evidence: gateway verb, router package, proxy package, with proxy/router.go and a Makefile router target that prints proxy status. launch package holds install and doctor, while launching is agent/launch_*.go. plans vs review/plan. test verb maps to review/mutate and review/ramdisk. review verb (detectors) vs agent review (LLM). agents verb vs agent package.

findings.title: File names have no single scheme
findings.evidence: cli: cmd_agent.go beside agent.go, opencodemodels.go beside network_browser.go. agent: opencodeauth.go beside copilot_auth.go, codexcatalog.go beside opencode_catalog.go, livebackend.go beside live_lock_unix.go, route.go beside routes.go, launcher.go beside launch_cli.go. hooks: agenteffort.go beside review_simplicity.go.
findings.fix: Adopt <area>_<topic>.go when each file is next touched. Do not run a rename-only sweep while another session is mid-rename.

findings.title: opencode billing is described two ways
findings.evidence: cli.go:64 menu says 'on your opencode Go plan'. cmd_agent.go:32 says 'on your Copilot plan'. agents/opencode.md says opencode Go plan; agent/target.go says OpenCode defaults to the Copilot plan.
findings.fix: State the real ladder once. Needs an owner decision on which text is right.

findings.title: Menu promises per-command help that tier verbs lack
findings.evidence: 'claude-code <command> -h' is the second line of the menu. opus, sonnet and haiku print upstream claude help, science prints claude-science help, and fable exits with 'profile dev has no fable model; pin one with...'.
findings.fix: Agent verbs already have --docs for upstream help. Give tier verbs the same -h and --docs split, and never resolve a profile for -h.

findings.title: describe, the agent-facing map, misses real flags
findings.evidence: It reads the completion spec. Missing: ask --host --live --env --direct --output-schema --system-prompt --append-system-prompt; configure --all --drop --keep --no-agents; usage --show; doctor --refresh; gateway --profile; all review tool flags; preflight --live --refresh. Short flags print wrongly as --f, --n, --k, --o. install lists '--setup' as a subverb. Tab completion lacks the same flags.
findings.fix: Register flags in one table that help, completion and describe all read, and print short flags with one dash.

findings.title: Core verbs are hidden
findings.evidence: ask, agents, models, review, preflight and workflow are hidden. CLAUDE.md names ask as the first command for dispatch, and configure help and errors point at models. cli.go:87 says hidden verbs are 'named in the trailing note', but the menu has no such note.
findings.fix: Show ask, agents, models and review; keep plumbing hidden (hook, resolve, clip*, wl-paste, help-svg). Correct the comment.

findings.title: Menu groups misfile verbs
findings.evidence: network is under AUTH. databricks is under AGENTS though it launches Claude on a provider. cli.go:54 labels the first rows AGENTS while they are ANTHROPIC.

findings.title: network is a grab-bag
findings.evidence: network view reads local transcripts. network restart restarts the proxy, while gateway proxy has --start and --stop. network websearch is a stdio MCP server. network vscode serves a UI, but theme vscode merges settings.
findings.fix: P11. Move view to agents view, and restart to gateway.

findings.title: Several verbs do the same job
findings.evidence: Pin a profile: switch, configure --profile, <agent> profile. Pin models: models --pin, configure models. Health: doctor, configure doctor, preflight, <agent> setup. Catalog: <agent> catalog, models --live. Jobs: agents status|result|tail|cancel, <agent> status|result|tail|cancel. 'review' means detectors at top level and an LLM review under an agent.
findings.fix: Keep one owner per action. configure may link to it. Rename top-level review to lint-style wording or fold it under test.

findings.title: Mode flags and subcommands are mixed
findings.evidence: Subcommands: vault list, worktree list, history log. Mode flags: gateway proxy --start|--stop|--status|--serve, network tailscale --machines|--key|--connect, network vscode --stop|--status, doctor --audit|--scan|--git, network remote --list, clean --list.
findings.fix: Actions become subcommands; flags only modify an action.

findings.title: Flag vocabulary drifts
findings.evidence: Output: --json and --output (review) vs --format, --out, and -o (network browser). -f is config (codex), follow (tail) and format (review report). Directory: --repo, --cwd, --workdir, --dir, --folder. Preview: --dry-run vs --check. Consent: --yes vs --force. --bg exists only on agents tree. -p is profile only on databricks.
findings.fix: Write a short flag dictionary into rules/ and apply it with P11.

findings.title: proxy is documented as router
findings.evidence: The package doc reads 'Package router is the loopback model router'. The AuthGate comment says 'injected because route imports router', which no longer applies.
findings.fix: Correct with P7.

findings.title: inflight's doc claims imports it does not have
findings.evidence: 'it imports only paths and proc'; it also imports providers and router, through caps.go.
findings.fix: True again after P6.

findings.title: Package docs reference gone names
findings.evidence: web cites internal/agenttree and internal/dispatch. setup cites a 'setup' CLI verb. tools says 'agent agent CLIs'. review/* describe which Python scripts they ported rather than what they do. worktree and memory carry 'Phase N' comments. README.md:385 still documents claude-code dispatch, which exits with unknown command; ask --host and network remote replaced it.

findings.title: Missing or accidental package docs
findings.evidence: None: agent/preflight, agent/tree, launch, vault/vaulttest. A file note became the package doc in configure, hooks, memory, usage, vault, proc and ui/helptext. cli/memory.go still prints 'memory doctor', though the verb is memory review.
findings.fix: P1. One doc.go line per package.

findings.title: Dead seam
findings.evidence: network/vscode.BeforeWrite has no production setter.
findings.fix: Delete it, or make it a test-only seam.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md says router nests under agent; disk disagrees, and the reason does not hold
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md: a group only dispatch uses nests as internal/agent/<pkg> (router, ...). internal/agent/router does not exist at this audit. router has 9 importers, including databricks, proc/inflight, usage and hooks, so it is not dispatch-only.
findings.fix: Decide before more moves land. A nested router is cycle-safe, as router does not import agent, but it would be another Kind B child at a lower layer than its parent. Recommendation: keep it top-level beside proxy.

findings.title: copilot SDK imported outside its box
findings.evidence: internal/agent/copilot_registry.go:21 imports github.com/github/copilot-sdk/go.

findings.title: bbolt and mdsmith are not boxed
findings.evidence: bbolt: vault, memory, proxy, setup. mdsmith: agent/project, hooks, memory.
findings.fix: Decide whether the rule covers libraries. If it does, add thin wrappers; otherwise narrow the CLAUDE.md wording to SDKs.

findings.title: Open duplication reports still apply
